author: Steam (Valve) YouTube
text:
Steam Autumn Sale 2026: Official Trailer
The Steam Autumn Sale brings in deals on games throughout the entire Steam Store.  All week long you'll find sales on games of every size and genre: from big franchises and giant adventures, to cozy shops, deckbuilders, and story-rich titles. 

Grab your pumpkin spice latte and join us for Steam Autumn Sale, from October 1st through October 8th at 10 a.m. Pacific on Steam.

https://store.steampowered.com/
